prettier.scope: all repository files supported by Prettier

evidence: The product JavaScript surface is one Node verifier module plus its integration-heavy node:test suite.
The private package publishes no exports map; the verifier module is consumed only by its repository test suite and CLI.
npm test exercises the supported and rejected catalog, manifest, archive, route, and semver behaviors end to end.
typeChecking.decision: Do not introduce checkJs annotations or a TypeScript build solely to duplicate the current runtime contract tests.
typeChecking.revisitWhen: Add type checking when the package exposes a supported external API or splits the verifier into multiple reusable modules.
